title: 0050 Manager 업체 제작 의뢰 — 의뢰 · 본사 추천은 서버만, 같은 업체 설계 · 열린 의뢰 하나, 상태 차례 · 다음 차례 추천 · 답 기다림 하나 · 기한 24시간 · 답은 한 번, 받은 팩토리 프로젝트 · 설계 사본, 지우기 없음, 앱 알림 종류 셋 (scripts/rls-probe.mjs --migration database/migrations/0050_production_requests.sql)
setup: INSERT INTO public.companies (id, kind, name, plan, status) VALUES ({{company_m}}, 'partner', 'probe M', 'manager', 'active'), ({{company_m2}}, 'partner', 'probe M2', 'manager', 'active'), ({{company_f}}, 'partner', 'probe F', 'expert', 'active'), ({{company_g}}, 'partner', 'probe G', 'agent', 'active')
INSERT INTO public.company_members (company_id, user_id, role, status) VALUES ({{company_m}}, {{m_owner_user}}, 'owner', 'active'), ({{company_f}}, {{f_owner_user}}, 'owner', 'active')

INSERT INTO public.planner_drafts (company_id, id, name, item, model, rev, created_by) VALUES ({{company_m}}, 'd-probe-a', 'probe', 'sink', '{"id":"d-probe-a"}'::jsonb, 2, {{m_owner_user}}), ({{company_m}}, 'd-probe-b', 'probe', 'sink', '{"id":"d-probe-b"}'::jsonb, 1, {{m_owner_user}}), ({{company_m}}, 'd-probe-c', 'probe', 'wardrobe', '{"id":"d-probe-c"}'::jsonb, 1, {{m_owner_user}}), ({{company_m}}, 'd-probe-d', 'probe', 'sink', '{"id":"d-probe-d"}'::jsonb, 1, {{m_owner_user}}), ({{company_f}}, 'd-probe-f', 'probe', 'sink', '{"id":"d-probe-f"}'::jsonb, 1, {{f_owner_user}}), ({{company_f}}, 'd-probe-f2', 'probe', 'sink', '{"id":"d-probe-f2"}'::jsonb, 1, {{f_owner_user}})
INSERT INTO public.customers (id, company_id, name) VALUES ({{cust_m}}, {{company_m}}, 'probe'), ({{cust_f}}, {{company_f}}, 'probe M')
INSERT INTO public.projects (id, company_id, customer_id, title) VALUES ({{project_m}}, {{company_m}}, {{cust_m}}, 'probe'), ({{proj_f}}, {{company_f}}, {{cust_f}}, 'probe')
INSERT INTO public.designs (id, user_id, name, company_id) VALUES ({{design_m}}, {{m_owner_user}}, 'probe', {{company_m}})

INSERT INTO public.production_requests (id, company_id, draft_id, draft_rev, design_id, project_id, item, note, created_by) VALUES ({{req_a}}, {{company_m}}, 'd-probe-a', 2, {{design_m}}, {{project_m}}, 'sink', 'probe', {{m_owner_user}}), ({{req_b}}, {{company_m}}, 'd-probe-b', 1, NULL, NULL, 'sink', NULL, {{m_owner_user}}), ({{req_c}}, {{company_m}}, 'd-probe-c', 1, NULL, NULL, 'wardrobe', NULL, {{m_owner_user}})

INSERT INTO public.production_recommendations (id, request_id, company_id, round, rank, note) VALUES ({{rec_c1}}, {{req_c}}, {{company_f}}, 1, 1, 'probe'), ({{rec_c2}}, {{req_c}}, {{company_g}}, 1, 2, NULL)
UPDATE public.production_requests SET status = 'recommended', round = 1 WHERE id = {{req_c}}
UPDATE public.production_recommendations SET chosen = true WHERE id = {{rec_c1}}
UPDATE public.production_requests SET status = 'chosen', factory_company_id = {{company_f}} WHERE id = {{req_c}}

checks.name: 의뢰 읽기 — 서버만 (익명 · 의뢰한 업체 대표도 deny)
checks.sql: select count(*) from public.production_requests where company_id = {{company_m}}

checks.name: 추천 읽기 — 서버만
checks.sql: select count(*) from public.production_recommendations where request_id = {{req_c}}

checks.name: 구성원은 넣지 못한다
checks.sql: insert into public.production_requests (company_id, draft_id, draft_rev) values ({{company_m}}, 'd-probe-b', 1)

checks.name: 구성원은 고치지 못한다
checks.sql: update public.production_requests set status = 'cancelled' where id = {{req_b}}

checks.name: 지우기 없음 — 서버도 (의뢰)
checks.sql: delete from public.production_requests where id = {{req_b}}

checks.name: 지우기 없음 — 서버도 (추천)
checks.sql: delete from public.production_recommendations where id = {{rec_c2}}

checks.name: 설계 없는 의뢰는 거절
checks.sql: insert into public.production_requests (company_id) values ({{company_m}})

checks.name: 남의 업체 플래너 설계는 거절 (복합 FK)
checks.sql: insert into public.production_requests (company_id, draft_id, draft_rev) values ({{company_m2}}, 'd-probe-a', 1)

checks.name: 남의 업체 프로젝트는 거절 (복합 FK)
checks.sql: insert into public.production_requests (company_id, draft_id, draft_rev, project_id) values ({{company_m}}, 'd-probe-d', 1, {{proj_f}})

checks.name: 같은 플래너 설계로 열린 의뢰는 하나
checks.sql: insert into public.production_requests (company_id, draft_id, draft_rev) values ({{company_m}}, 'd-probe-a', 2)

checks.name: 같은 앱 설계로 열린 의뢰는 하나
checks.sql: insert into public.production_requests (company_id, design_id) values ({{company_m}}, {{design_m}})

checks.name: 거둔 의뢰의 설계는 다시 의뢰할 수 있다
checks.sql: update public.production_requests set status = 'cancelled' where id = {{req_b}}; insert into public.production_requests (company_id, draft_id, draft_rev) values ({{company_m}}, 'd-probe-b', 1)

checks.name: 의뢰 내용은 그대로
checks.sql: update public.production_requests set note = 'probe 2' where id = {{req_a}}

checks.name: 검토 시작 submitted → recommending
checks.sql: update public.production_requests set status = 'recommending' where id = {{req_b}}

checks.name: 건너뛰기는 거절 (submitted → chosen)
checks.sql: update public.production_requests set status = 'chosen', factory_company_id = {{company_f}} where id = {{req_b}}

checks.name: 되돌리기는 거절 (chosen → recommended)
checks.sql: update public.production_requests set status = 'recommended', factory_company_id = NULL where id = {{req_c}}

checks.name: 추천 — 다음 차례 줄을 넣고 의뢰를 recommended 로
checks.sql: insert into public.production_recommendations (request_id, company_id, round, rank) values ({{req_b}}, {{company_f}}, 1, 1), ({{req_b}}, {{company_g}}, 1, 2); update public.production_requests set status = 'recommended', round = 1, hq_note = 'probe' where id = {{req_b}}; select r.status || '/' || r.round || '/' || (select count(*) from public.production_recommendations x where x.request_id = r.id) from public.production_requests r where r.id = {{req_b}}

checks.name: 추천 차례는 추천할 때만 (recommending 그대로 round 1 은 거절)
checks.sql: update public.production_requests set round = 1 where id = {{req_a}}

checks.name: 지금 차례 이하 추천은 거절
checks.sql: insert into public.production_recommendations (request_id, company_id, round, rank) values ({{req_c}}, {{company_m2}}, 1, 3)

checks.name: 새 추천은 고르기 · 답 없이
checks.sql: insert into public.production_recommendations (request_id, company_id, round, rank, chosen) values ({{req_c}}, {{company_g}}, 2, 1, true)

checks.name: 같은 차례에 같은 팩토리 두 번은 거절
checks.sql: insert into public.production_recommendations (request_id, company_id, round, rank) values ({{req_c}}, {{company_g}}, 2, 1), ({{req_c}}, {{company_g}}, 2, 2)

checks.name: 고른 줄 — 기한은 고른 때 + 24시간 (트리거가 찍는다)
checks.sql: select extract(epoch from (x.expires_at - x.chosen_at))::int from public.production_recommendations x where x.id = {{rec_c1}}

checks.name: 답 기다리는 줄은 의뢰에 하나
checks.sql: update public.production_recommendations set chosen = true where id = {{rec_c2}}

checks.name: 고른 줄은 되돌리지 못한다
checks.sql: update public.production_recommendations set chosen = false where id = {{rec_c1}}

checks.name: 받기 — 의뢰 accepted + 팩토리 프로젝트, 추천 줄 답 · 답한 때
checks.sql: update public.production_requests set status = 'accepted', factory_project_id = {{proj_f}} where id = {{req_c}}; update public.production_recommendations set response = 'accepted', responded_by = {{f_owner_user}} where id = {{rec_c1}}; select r.status || '/' || (x.responded_at is not null)::text from public.production_requests r join public.production_recommendations x on x.request_id = r.id where x.id = {{rec_c1}}

checks.name: 받기 — 다른 업체 프로젝트로는 잇지 못한다 (복합 FK)
checks.sql: update public.production_requests set status = 'accepted', factory_project_id = {{project_m}} where id = {{req_c}}

checks.name: 받은 뒤 설계 사본 한 번 적기
checks.sql: update public.production_requests set status = 'accepted', factory_project_id = {{proj_f}} where id = {{req_c}}; update public.production_requests set factory_draft_id = 'd-probe-f' where id = {{req_c}}

checks.name: 설계 사본은 바꾸지 못한다
checks.sql: update public.production_requests set status = 'accepted', factory_project_id = {{proj_f}} where id = {{req_c}}; update public.production_requests set factory_draft_id = 'd-probe-f' where id = {{req_c}}; update public.production_requests set factory_draft_id = 'd-probe-f2' where id = {{req_c}}

checks.name: 못 받음 → 고른 팩토리를 비우고 다음 차례로 다시 추천
checks.sql: update public.production_requests set status = 'declined' where id = {{req_c}}; update public.production_recommendations set response = 'declined', reason = 'probe' where id = {{rec_c1}}; insert into public.production_recommendations (request_id, company_id, round, rank) values ({{req_c}}, {{company_g}}, 2, 1); update public.production_requests set status = 'recommended', round = 2, factory_company_id = NULL where id = {{req_c}}; select status || '/' || round || '/' || coalesce(factory_company_id::text, 'none') from public.production_requests where id = {{req_c}}

checks.name: 다시 추천하며 고른 팩토리를 남기면 거절
checks.sql: update public.production_requests set status = 'declined' where id = {{req_c}}; update public.production_requests set status = 'recommended', round = 2 where id = {{req_c}}

checks.name: 팩토리 답은 한 번
checks.sql: update public.production_recommendations set response = 'declined' where id = {{rec_c1}}; update public.production_recommendations set response = 'accepted' where id = {{rec_c1}}

checks.name: 사유는 못 받음만
checks.sql: update public.production_recommendations set response = 'expired', reason = 'probe' where id = {{rec_c1}}

checks.name: 끝난 의뢰는 그대로 (거둔 뒤 다시 열기 거절)
checks.sql: update public.production_requests set status = 'cancelled' where id = {{req_b}}; update public.production_requests set status = 'recommending' where id = {{req_b}}

checks.name: 앱 알림 — 새 제작 의뢰(production_offered) 넣어짐
checks.sql: insert into public.notification_outbox (user_id, company_id, kind, title, body, url) values ({{f_owner_user}}, {{company_f}}, 'production_offered', '새 제작 의뢰', '제작 의뢰가 왔습니다.', '/segan/me.html#factory-requests')

checks.name: 앱 알림 — 모르는 종류는 거절
checks.sql: insert into public.notification_outbox (user_id, company_id, kind, title, body, url) values ({{f_owner_user}}, {{company_f}}, 'production_probe', 'probe', 'probe', '/segan/me.html')
